title: Decoupling Inference from State Updates in Low-Latency Feature Engines via Probabilistic Thinning
title_zh: 通过概率稀疏化在低延迟特征引擎中解耦推理与状态更新
abstract_en: Streaming data systems increasingly underpin Machine Learning workflows that maintain large numbers of continuously updated aggregations. In production settings, each incoming event typically triggers read-modify-write operations to persistent storage, making high-frequency state updates a dominant source of latency, contention, and operational cost. In this work, we decouple inference from state persistence in streaming Machine Learning pipelines via probabilistic thinning: every event is scored, but durable state updates are selectively triggered by informative events. Unlike approaches that shed input or state, we show that persistence-path control is achievable without a high-frequency in-memory control plane or cross-worker coordination, relying exclusively on approximate statistics retrieved from disk-backed key-value stores. We model the resulting stochastic processes, derive bounds on filtering rates, and prove that common time-based aggregations remain unbiased under variance-aware formulations, preventing systemic error accumulation. We evaluate the approach in a controlled setting that isolates per-event costs, demonstrating substantial reductions in storage Input/Output and serialization overhead. Across experiments, up to 90% of events are excluded from the persistence path while preserving and in some cases improving downstream utility.
abstract_zh: 本文面向流式 Machine Learning 特征管线中高频持久化状态更新带来的延迟、竞争与成本问题，提出通过概率稀疏化（probabilistic thinning）将推理与状态持久化解耦：每个事件仍会参与打分，但只有信息量较高的事件才触发持久化状态更新。与丢弃输入或状态的方法不同，该方法不依赖高频内存控制平面或跨 worker 协调，仅使用从磁盘型 key-value store 中读取的近似统计量进行持久化路径控制。论文对由此产生的随机过程建模，推导过滤率边界，并证明在方差感知（variance-aware）形式下，常见基于时间的聚合仍保持无偏，从而避免系统性误差累积。实验在隔离单事件成本的受控环境中验证，该方法显著减少存储 I/O 与序列化开销，最多可将 90% 事件排除在持久化路径之外，同时保持甚至提升下游任务效用。
key_points_zh: 提出将每事件推理与持久化状态更新解耦：事件全部被 scored，但仅部分“有信息量”的事件触发 durable state update。
方法不需要高频 in-memory control plane 或跨 worker coordination，仅依赖 disk-backed key-value stores 中的近似统计量，便于生产系统落地。
从随机过程角度建模 probabilistic thinning，给出过滤率边界，并证明方差感知的时间聚合在常见场景下保持无偏。
实验显示该方法可显著降低 storage I/O 与 serialization overhead，最多过滤掉 90% 的持久化更新事件。
在减少状态更新成本的同时，下游 utility 基本保持，部分实验中甚至有所提升。

llm_assessment.comment: The feature-engine optimization is useful ML infrastructure but has minimal direct relevance to agent runtime, orchestration, or self-improvement.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该特征引擎优化对机器学习基础设施有用，但与智能体运行、编排或自我改进几乎没有直接关系。
